Theorem
[Completion of the unit-scale proof] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0199, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0200 ↗ clm:chow-iii-uniform-negative-local-entropy ↗ lem:chow-iii-noncollapsed-entropy-limit ↗ lem:chow-iii-collapsed-entropy-limit ↗ thm:chow-iii-pseudolocality-unit-scale 1. ch21:21.66–21.68\group Logarithmic Sobolev contradiction

The negative local entropy furnished by Claim 3 propagates to time zero through the localized adjoint heat-kernel estimate. After the normalization $\dot g_i(0)=(2\widetilde t_i)^{-1}g_i(0)$ and $\psi _i^2=(2\widetilde t_i)^{n/2}\widetilde H_i$, it yields \[ \int \bigl(2|\nabla \psi _i|^2-\psi _i^2\log \psi _i^2-s_n\psi _i^2\bigr) \, d\mu _{\dot g_i(0)}\le -\frac{\beta _1}{2}\int \psi _i^2\, d\mu _{\dot g_i(0)}. \] The almost Euclidean isoperimetric inequality and the logarithmic Sobolev inequality give the opposite lower bound with coefficient $s_n+\log (1-\delta _i)$. Since $\delta _i\to 0$, this is a contradiction, proving the unit-scale theorem and, by scaling, Theorem 1.
